description: HushPinterest v0.0.5: 23 patches for Pinterest 14.38.0, and the same set for 14.25.0 on Android 9. New in this release: Download pin saves image pins at full size, Original-quality images in pin closeups, Remove ad tracking permissions, wider Disable analytics coverage, Hide topic suggestions and Spoof signature for Google sign-in. Validation: 693 runtime tests passed. All 170 patch tests passed. All 23 patches applied without forcing to Pinterest 14.38.0 and 14.25.0. Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Pinterest APK. Uninstall the stock app first, then sign in with your email and a Pinterest password.
